privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.summary: We collect only what is needed to arrange and record your care, keep it encrypted and stored in Rwanda, show it only to the staff caring for you, and let you see, correct and download it.

sections.title: Who is responsible
sections.body: The operator of MediLink ([To confirm]) and each health facility that cares for you are responsible for your data, under Law No. 058/2021 on the protection of personal data and privacy.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Your name, contact details, date of birth, sex, identifiers such as your national ID or insurance number, your bookings and queue tickets, and the records health facilities write about your visits.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To find and book care, run the queue, keep your health records, bill and claim insurance, send you reminders, and keep the service safe. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: Where it is kept
sections.body: On servers in Rwanda, encrypted in transit and at rest. Health records can be opened only by staff at a facility that is caring for you, and every opening is logged.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can see who opened your record, download your data, ask for corrections, and close your account. Facilities must keep medical records for the period the law requires.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Medical records are kept as long as the law requires ([To confirm]); other data is deleted or anonymised when no longer needed.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions or complaints: our data protection officer at [To confirm]. You can also contact the National Cyber Security Authority.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.summary: MediLink helps you find, book and track care. The care itself is given by the health facility. MediLink is not for emergencies and its symptom checker gives guidance, not a diagnosis.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: Keep your password private. You may manage profiles for your children and people you care for, and share access with others you trust.

sections.title: Bookings and the queue
sections.body: Arrive on time or cancel before the deadline. If you arrive late, you are checked in as a walk-in. Bookings you miss without cancelling count as no-shows, and repeated no-shows can limit new bookings for a while.

sections.title: Not for emergencies
sections.body: In an emergency call 912 or go to the nearest emergency department.

sections.title: Guidance, not diagnosis
sections.body: The symptom checker suggests how soon to seek care and which kind. It does not diagnose. Only a clinician can.

sections.title: Facilities and care
sections.body: Health facilities are independent and responsible for the care they give, their prices and their records.

sections.title: Fair use
sections.body: Do not misuse the service, impersonate others or try to access data that is not yours.

sections.title: Liability and law
sections.body: [To confirm] These terms are governed by the laws of Rwanda.
